name: MiST -second edition-
source:
Main character goes out on a trip with his five friends during summer vacations. In this picturesque mountain landscape he gets to know many secrets about his friends.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-july-2002-viper-rsr.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公暑假与5名朋友出游。在风景如画的山地景观中，他发现了朋友们的许多秘密。
